0022600116.text: The Clippers (1-1, 7th in the West) are coming off a loss and are 0-1 on the road, while the Oklahoma City Thunder (2-0, 1st in the Northwest) enter on a two-game winning streak. The Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), and the Thunder are without Nikola Topic (back surgery), Otega Oweh (Achilles surgery) and Thomas Sorber (knee surgery). The teams have not played yet in 2026-27, but the Clippers lost all three meetings to Oklahoma City in 2025-26, most recently 128-110 in Los Angeles on April 8, 2026.
